items.stem: What is the ion product, Q, for AgCl in this mixture?

options.why: Divides one concentration by the other.
Takes the square of the first concentration.
Takes the square root of the product of the concentrations.

items.stem: The K_sp of AgCl is $1.8 × 10⁻¹⁰$. By what factor is Q greater or less than K_sp (that is, what is Q/K_sp)?

options.why: Inverts the ratio and divides Ksp by Q.
Divides the first ion concentration alone by Ksp.
Divides the sum of the two concentrations by Ksp.

stimulus.description: A hot metal sample is placed in water in an insulated calorimeter

rows: Final temperature of metal and water (°C)

items.stem: What is the heat gained by the water, in J? (The specific heat of water is 4.18 J/(g °C).)

options.why: Uses the temperature change of the metal instead of the temperature change of the water.
Forgets the mass of the water.
Uses the final temperature of the mixture instead of the temperature change of the water.
